referenceDefiningTraits: Notebook horizontal ruling with a left vertical margin line.
Slightly skewed, doubled pencil-like rectangle and document outlines.
Diagonal crosshatching in dedicated regions around large readable central text.
Bold type hierarchy, understated underlines and organically curved arrow paths.
Light and dark examples preserve the same construction with adapted contrast.
retainedTraits: Notebook ruling and margin, lightly irregular double outlines, hatch-filled panels with clear label fields, bold primary labels and drawn arrowheads recur across the five captures.
Curves, straight steps and dashed progress lines are used for the respective flow meanings.
losses: Pencil texture is more regular and faint, and shape alignment is more orderly than the references; the rough hand-made quality is reduced.
The folded PNG document motif is absent; this is a compositional difference, not a missing brief requirement.
overrideAssessment: Common palette and Japanese sans-serif requirements supersede the reference colors and Latin lettering. Pattern, Text, MAKE and PNG are reference content rather than required labels. The dark reference was inspected, but this batch provides only light artwork, so a dark batch adaptation is not evaluated.

observations: Three large boxes read left to right as 申請 → 確認待ち → 確定. A clock and explicit reservation-not-yet-confirmed note separate the middle state from completion.
The teal return path starts at 確定, carries 日時を変更, and points back into 確認待ち. The accompanying sentence says confirmed reservations only and no automatic approval.
Bold state labels, restrained supporting text and ample arrow spacing create clear hierarchy. Hatching sits above and below label fields without obscuring text.

character.reason: The defining notebook geometry, bold type and hatch texture remain recognizable in all ratios. Cleaner construction and lower hatch prominence limit the expressive pencil character relative to the originals.

batch.factualCorrectness: All checklist facts and complete required labels are visible. No material omissions, inventions or reversals observed.

uncertainties.font: Raster inspection cannot establish the actually resolved font family or fallback. Japanese glyphs appear intact; no visible tofu or missing-glyph boxes. Noto Sans CJK JP use is unverified.
uncertainties.scale: Capture dimensions exceed each target by 48 pixels horizontally and 96 vertically, consistent with placement framing. I inspected all captures via view_image at their displayed native dimensions and judged the target artwork inside the frame; placement metadata and source were not read. No separate browser/device rendering was verified.
uncertainties.palette: Role usage is visually consistent: teal highlights/completion or available paths, orange conditional warning branches, dark ink and subdued borders. Exact sampled color compliance was not tested.

scope: Only dispatched references, five capture PNGs, corresponding brief.md/checklist.json files and common palette.json were read. No source SVG, prompt, condition, run-record, schemes/kits, coordinator scores or other runs were inspected. No browser/network/git or descendants used.
